name: Plate Armor of Etherealness
summary: Plate armor that lets you step into the Ethereal Plane once a day.

stats.effect: While you're wearing this armor, you can take a {ref:glossary/magic} action and use a command word to gain the effect of the *{ref:spell/etherealness}* spell. The spell ends immediately if you remove the armor or take a Magic action to repeat the command word. This property of the armor can't be used again until the next dawn.
